RGL Ban: Game Exploit - Sniper Scope Removal - Warning

A warning was issued to inform the player that this mod is not allowed to be used in scrims and was informed to remove it from their computer, which they have complied with. [1003.1] - Cheating was updated to add that evidence of cheating anywhere in TF2, including public servers, scrims, and PUGs (Pick-Up Games) applies to all the sections listed on a case-by-case basis depending on the intent and impact where it occurred. Previously, it was not clear in the rulebook that game exploits, such as snipe scope transparency, were enforced outside of RGL matches. As the player had no previous experience in RGL, this also served as an additional reason for AC's decision to issue a warning in this specific case. Any usage of the mod moving forward in TF2 will lead to league suspensions.
